subject: POC kickoff & hands-on prompt lab — slotting and traffic plan

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@treeline.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & hands-on prompt lab — availability and prep materials

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the hands-on prompt review and routing workshop with our engineers. We want to get the POC kickoff on the calendar and make sure we have the right prep items in place. High level asks from our side: prompt inventory review, routing & structured-output mapping, and a short load test to validate throughput at peak.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 20 — 09:00–12:00 (prompt inventory + routing deep-dive)
- Wed Jul 21 — 09:00–11:00 (structured output & guardrails)
- Thu Jul 22 — 09:00–10:30 (integration Q&A / wrap)

I attached our current prompt inventory (treeline_prompt_inventory.xlsx) and a small sample payload (treeline_sample_payload.jsonl). Can your team confirm:
1) Which Redwood engineers should join each block?
2) Whether you can run a controlled load window (we can do a separate date if needed) — we'd like to validate ~200 rps sustained for 10 minutes.
3) Any constraints for structured-output validation (JSON schema requirements, allowed tokens, etc.).

If those windows don't work we can push to the following week. Also cc'ing our ops lead Maria who will help coordinate the load test.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering
Treeline Analytics

Hi Alex — great to see the agenda draft and thanks for the inventory. We can support the three blocks you proposed. Quick notes:

- Ben (SE) will lead the prompt review and routing session — he can map prompts to templates and suggest batching/caching knobs.
- Connor (Solutions) will run structured-output/guardrails and coordinate schema validation.
- I will run the integration Q&A and operations handoff.

Proposed concrete slots (all PDT) — please pick one option per day:
- Tue Jul 20: 09:00–11:30 OR 13:00–15:30
- Wed Jul 21: 09:00–11:00 (we prefer morning for schema work)
- Thu Jul 22: 09:00–10:30

For the load test: we can run a 200 rps controlled run but would prefer a dedicated slot the week after (to isolate telemetry). Suggest Thu Jul 29 09:00–10:30 PDT for the traffic window if that works for you. If you need earlier we can try Wed Jul 28 in the afternoon.

Before the kickoff please:
- Share the canonical JSON schema(s) you want us to validate (or a sample).
- Flag any PII/PHI in the sample payloads.

I attached a short lab runbook (redwood_lab-runbook.pdf) and will send calendar invites once we confirm.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & hands-on prompt lab — technical checklist and breakout plan

Alex — quick tech checklist and proposed breakout structure so we make the most of each block:

1) Prompt inventory (Tue Jul 20) — goals: canonicalize prompt templates, identify prefix caching opportunities, highlight hallucination-prone prompts. Bring 10–15 representative prompts (we saw your inventory).
2) Routing & batching (Tue Jul 20 breakout) — map flows to route policies (latency vs cost), discuss fallback model variants.
3) Structured-output & guardrails (Wed Jul 21) — we'll validate JSON schemas, test structured output with function-calling style prompts, and discuss reject/fallback rules. Please confirm schema versioning policy.
4) Integration Q&A (Thu Jul 22) — ops handoff, auth/KMS expectations, network egress.

Load test notes:
- We'll provision a dedicated test pool and monitor token-level latency and error rates. If we see >5% error or median latency >600ms we will move traffic to a quantized variant to keep the session healthy.
- Please provide a non-prod endpoint and an API key scoped to the test; do not run tests against prod systems.

Attachments: none.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
